title: Giza pyramid stones may have been mixed and poured

tellings.quote: we might have poured the stones mied them and poured them

plain: The stones of the Giza pyramids in Egypt may not have been cut and hauled at all, but mixed and poured into place like concrete. Joe McMoneagle, a researcher, says this to Michels, crediting a book called The Ultimate Time Machine. If true, the builders had a casting technique that changes how the pyramids were made.
